items.title: DIA considering new AI-powered platform to streamline procurement system | DefenseScoop
items.snippet: The release of the RFI comes as the Pentagon and IC are on the hunt for new AI t...
items.raw_snippet: The release of the RFI comes as the Pentagon and IC are on the hunt for new AI tools to eliminate drudge work for their employees and streamline back-office functions. The Defense Intelligence Agency is taking steps toward the potential launch of an artificial intelligence prototype project as it seeks new technologies to overcome inefficiencies in its procurement enterprise. The DIA — which has a workforce of more than 16,000 personnel and is tasked with providing intel support to the military and Intelligence Community — issued an RFI on June 17 to inform its pursuit of a next-generation, AI-powered “acquisition platform.”. The organization is “exploring innovative approaches to improve the effectiveness, usability, transparency, and speed of the federal acquisition lifecycle through an AI-enabled procurement environment integrated with FAR, DFAR, and Agency processes,” officials wrote in the sources-sought notice. The release of the RFI comes as the Pentagon and IC are on the hunt for new artificial intelligence and machine learning tools to eliminate drudge work for their employees and streamline back-office functions.

items.raw_snippet: 3. From Relationships to Acquisition Intelligence: Sumit Sahu on Affluense.ai. But Sumit Sahu, Co-founder and CEO of Affluense.ai, argues that relationships are no longer sufficient on their own. The market has changed: wealth is being created faster, across more private networks, and often before traditional prospecting systems can see it. The harder question is whether they know who to meet, when to act, and what to understand before the conversation begins. Affluense.ai has built its proposition around what Sumit describes as an acquisition operating system: a way for wealth firms to identify emerging HNI opportunities, research clients in depth, track meaningful triggers, and activate existing networks before competitors arrive first. * **Relationships remain valuable, but insufficient**: Sumit says relationships still matter, but firms lose when they treat them as the whole acquisition strategy rather than the starting point. * **India provides a demanding test case**: Affluense.ai was built in a market where wealth is often private, promoter-held and family-held, making it a difficult environment for client intelligence.

items.snippet: # Enable Real-Time AI for High-Speed Data Acquisition with DAQIRI. * NVIDIA DAQI...
items.raw_snippet: # Enable Real-Time AI for High-Speed Data Acquisition with DAQIRI. * NVIDIA DAQIRI transforms scientific data acquisition by providing a software-centric, high-throughput pipeline that bypasses traditional hardware bottlenecks, enabling direct, zero-copy streaming of high-bandwidth detector data to GPU memory for real-time AI processing. * Integration with the broader NVIDIA Holoscan Platform, including TensorRT and nvCOMP, allows developers to build modular, low-latency workflows for tasks such as filtering, inference, compression, and adaptive control, with YAML-driven configuration and C++/Python APIs. * The A-GHOST project at CERN employs DAQIRI to connect FPGA-based hardware directly to GPU farms, enabling AI-driven analysis of previously discarded HL-LHC data streams using advanced models like Convolutional Auto-Encoders and transformer-based architectures in real time. Measured data is the backbone for all AI models and workflows that process data as it’s created, act on what matters in real time, and analyzes data for deep insights. NVIDIA DAQIRI (Data Acquisition for Integrated Real-time Instruments) shifts the data acquisition to an adaptable, software-centric architecture from an inflexible hardware-centric design.
